article_title: First catch aborted in SpaceX Starship rocket double-catch test

tasks.prompt: What is the main development reported in the article?
options: SpaceX cancelled all future Starship launches
SpaceX aborted the booster catch but continued the flight and considered a later upper-stage catch
The Starship failed to leave its launchpad
Both stages were successfully caught on the launch tower
tasks.correct_answer: SpaceX aborted the booster catch but continued the flight and considered a later upper-stage catch
tasks.explanation_hebrew: SpaceX ויתרה על תפיסת המאיץ התחתון והסיטה אותו לים, בעוד השלב העליון המשיך במסלולו ואפשרות תפיסתו נותרה פתוחה.

tasks.prompt: What are the launch tower's mechanical arms nicknamed?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הזרועות המכאניות של מגדל השיגור מכונות chopsticks, כלומר מקלות אכילה.

tasks.prompt: What is the Ship deploying during its journey to space?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השלב העליון משגר 26 לוויינים שיצטרפו למערך Starlink המספק אינטרנט מהחלל.

tasks.prompt: What does “paving the way” mean in the discussion of full rocket recovery?
options: Making a future development possible or easier
Building a road beside the launchpad
tasks.correct_answer: Making a future development possible or easier
tasks.explanation_hebrew: paving the way פירושו להכין את התנאים להתפתחות עתידית, כאן שימוש חוזר מלא ברקטה.

tasks.prompt: How many Earth orbits was the Ship due to complete before returning?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה-Ship אמור להשלים 14 הקפות סביב כדור הארץ ולחזור למגדל 22.5 שעות לאחר ההמראה.

tasks.prompt: When Prof Malcolm Macdonald says reusability could change the “economics of accessing space”, what does he mean?
options: It could change who owns the Moon
It could substantially alter the cost and business model of launches
It could eliminate the need for satellites
It could make every test flight successful
tasks.correct_answer: It could substantially alter the cost and business model of launches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה היא ששימוש חוזר עשוי להפחית עלויות ולשנות מן היסוד את המודל הכלכלי של שיגורים לחלל.

tasks.prompt: Why did SpaceX divert the booster to the ocean instead of attempting the planned catch?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שההחלטה התקבלה בתנאי ניסוי ומתוך עדיפות לבטיחות, בלי להמציא תקלה שלא צוינה.
expected_points: The company was testing manoeuvres it had not performed before in this configuration
SpaceX said safety was its highest priority
The catch attempt could be abandoned if conditions were not suitable
The report does not specify a precise technical fault that forced the diversion

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the flight tested SpaceX's goal of making Starship fully reusable.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין שני שלבי הרקטה, תוצאות הניסוי והחשיבות הכלכלית.
expected_points: The Super Heavy booster was meant to be caught about six and a half minutes after launch
That first catch was aborted and the booster was diverted to the ocean
The Ship continued to orbit and a second catch could be attempted after assessment
SpaceX has caught boosters before but has never caught the upper stage
Recovering both stages could allow repeated flights and reduce launch costs

tasks.prompt: Why are Nasa and SpaceX shareholders both likely to follow this test closely?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את האינטרסים השונים של המשקיעים ושל נאס״א.
expected_points: Shareholders care whether full reusability can reduce costs and support SpaceX's business model
Starship's progress affects the value and credibility of the company
Nasa contracted SpaceX to turn the Ship into a lunar lander
Delays could affect ambitious Artemis and 2028 Moon-landing schedules

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph assessing why one successful catch would be important but not sufficient proof of full reusability.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב את דברי המומחה עם הצורך בביצועים חוזרים ובטוחים.
expected_points: A catch would demonstrate a transition from simply flying Starship to operating it differently
Full reusability requires recovery of both rocket stages
The system must work safely and repeatedly, not just once
Falcon 9 shows that frequent reuse can lower costs
Further progress is needed to meet Nasa commitments
